Do Google Ads work for small businesses?

Ava Digital · Updated 2026 · ~4 min read
Short answer: Yes — when set up correctly. Google Ads can deliver leads within days for local businesses, but wasted spend is common without tight targeting, negative keywords, and a strong landing page. Plan to test for 30–90 days to reach profitability.

When Google Ads work well

  • People search with high intent (“emergency plumber near me”).
  • You have a clear offer and a landing page built to convert.
  • Your margins can absorb a cost per lead and still profit.

Why they fail

  • Targeting too broad — burning budget on the wrong searches.
  • No negative keywords — paying for irrelevant clicks.
  • Weak landing page — clicks that never convert.
  • No conversion tracking — flying blind on what works.

A realistic budget

Most local small businesses need $1,000–$3,000/month to gather enough data to optimize. Judge success by cost per lead, not clicks.
